answers.workaround:
While I have not tested this, my expectation is that a user could iterate up through the parents until `get_parent()` returns `null`:

```gdscript
var parents = []
var current_node: Node = ...  # Target node goes here

while current_node != null:
    parents.append(current_node.get_name())
    current_node = current_node.get_parent()
    
parents.append("!")
parents.reverse()
return "/".join(parents)
```

title: Allow `Node.get_path()` to return existing hierarchy even when not in tree
